licenses:three.note: steam-user components/apps.js:983 `this.licenses = body.licenses`; body decoded by 03-messages.js _decodeProto with {longs: String}, so the 64-bit access_token is a decimal string and the uint32 fields are numbers. Synthetic ids only.

owned_apps:two.note: steam-user components/friends.js:835-870 getUserOwnedApps: {app_count: body.game_count, apps: body.games} with img_icon_url rewritten to a steamcdn-a URL when present (friends.js:857-859).

depot_key:ok.note: steam-user components/cdn.js:102-135 getDepotDecryptionKey resolves {key: Buffer}; expected is the hex of that Buffer.

depot_key:eresult2.note: cdn.js:117-119 rejects Helpers.eresultError(body.eresult), an Error carrying .eresult = 2.

request_code:big.note: steam-user components/cdn.js:281-300 getManifestRequestCode resolves {requestCode: body.manifest_request_code}; a uint64 decoded with {longs: String} is a decimal string, so a value above 2^53 stays exact.

content_servers:strings.note: steam-user components/cdn.js:22-92 getContentServers: keeps type CDN/SteamCache, drops servers whose allowed_app_ids excludes the appid, and maps to {type,sourceid,cell,load,preferred_server,weightedload,NumEntriesInClientList,Host,vhost,https_support,allowed_app_ids?}. The directory JSON carries load/weighted_load as strings (planModel.ts cycle-8 note); steam-user passes them through.

redeem:ok.note: steam-user components/apps.js:887-915 redeemKey. Receipt is a hand-built binary KV (MessageObject{LineItemCount,lineitems{0,1 each PackageID,ItemDescription}}) and expected was produced by running binarykvparser on it.

redeem:duplicate.note: apps.js:905-908: a non-OK eresult rejects with an Error carrying eresult, purchaseResultDetails and packageList (empty when LineItemCount is 0).

personas:one.note: steam-user components/friends.js:322-370 getPersonas resolves {personas: {[sid64]: user}}; friends.js:994-995 converts avatar_hash to a hex string. steam-user emits a larger user object; only player_name, persona_state and avatar_hash are read by GameLib.
